name: standing pose (form check: incorrect, front view)
description: A front-view standing posture example marked as incorrect. Use it as a prompt to check your own left-right alignment.
instructions: Stand facing a mirror with your feet about hip-width apart.
Check whether your weight is distributed evenly and your knees point in the same direction as your toes.
Look for level hips and shoulders instead of copying the example marked with a red cross.
Adjust to a comfortable, balanced stance and breathe normally.
